search_purpose: Find direct Hall/two-temperature fluid local ion/electron heating studies; identify numerical-vs-kinetic-vs-experimental boundaries and locate previous/following work.
sources_used: OSTI accepted-manuscript repository and DOI API
Local research/catalog.json, papers and verified records

queries.query: Browning Stanier ion electron heating two temperature Hall MHD 2016 2018
ST40 merging heating two fluid simulation ion electron temperature Browning
"Advanced modeling for the HIT-SI Experiment" paper

forward_trace_method: Exact-title searches and identified later papers' reference lists; no exhaustive cited-by database export. L247→L223 and L223→Stanier2013 are directly checked; unknown edges are not inferred from topic similarity.
deduplication: Compared DOI/title with local catalog. Existing L223/L164/L247/Stanier2013 retained. Kaptanoglu arXiv and accepted PDF are one work, erratum is linked correction rather than independent heating study. TS6FEC2025 title absent from catalog before download.

limits: This branch does not enumerate all raw search-engine hits and cannot supply a globally exhaustive recall rate.
Not a Scopus/Web of Science systematic cited-by graph; additional paywalled papers, theses and unpublished material may remain.
Unavailable L046 full text and Kaptanoglu erratum text remain explicit gaps.
Candidate-only entries are not scientific evidence in the review.
Some long-tail candidate metadata remains incomplete and is deliberately not promoted into global verified.
